title: Mulgirigala Raja Maha Vihara
displaytitle: Mulgirigala Raja Maha Vihara

titles.display: Mulgirigala Raja Maha Vihara

description: Ancient Buddhist temple in Sri Lanka
extract: Mulgirigala Raja Maha Vihara is an ancient Buddhist temple in Puttalam District, Sri Lanka. The temple is situated at Mullegama village, about 2.5 km (1.6 mi) far from the Nawagattegama town. The temple has been formally recognised by the Government as an archaeological site in Sri Lanka. It is believed that the temple was built by King Dappula during the Anuradhapura period. The monastery complex consisted of a number of caves and inscriptions, constructed about 300 years ago.
